delete.description: Deletes the selected aspects and logs the caller out everywhere. Pass account=true to delete only the caller's own account, which is what App Store Guideline 5.1.1(v) requires; the other aspects are a factory reset of the appliance. All four are opt-in and a request selecting none is rejected, so a truncated call cannot destroy anything. The confirm parameter must equal the authenticated username. Databases are dropped and re-migrated in place, so no restart is required. Repeat calls are idempotent. External device data is reached only when devices=true; a drive that is not attached at reset time keeps its data. Deleting the last account returns the appliance to first-boot setup by design. Aspects are independent: deleting the account or the database does NOT delete stored files, and files left behind are readable by whoever sets the appliance up next — the response reports filesRetained=true whenever that happens, so pass files=true as well to erase the data itself.
